scope: Legacy Surveys optical coadd cutouts in g, r, i, z; one file per available band; IMAGE and optional INVVAR are HDUs, not separate bands
preference: DR9 first for g/r/z; DR10-south then DR11 fallback. DR9 has no i band; i starts at DR10-south, then DR11-south.
availability_rule: FITS parses; requested band/release, shape, WCS center and pixel scale match; finite, nonconstant, nonzero IMAGE data; positive finite INVVAR where supplied (otherwise nonzero image coverage proxy). At least 50% of central 16×16 pixels covered. Central coverage below 90% and field coverage below 99% are explicitly flagged; all attempted FITS provenance is retained.
cutout_note: New sky-centered survey cutouts at the native display pixel scale inferred from saved geometry. They are not the transformed PNGs, fitted models, residual maps, or guaranteed original inputs.
